# CANDIDATE: COMBINED_MIDDAY_TRENDLINE_AND_STRUCTURE_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Combining the midday trendline gate (which suppresses low-quality trendline re-entries during 11:30-14:00 ET) with the structure veto (which blocks bearish PUT entries into confirmed 5m uptrends) will reduce false bearish signals during choppy midday periods and countertrend rallies, thereby improving edge capture on J's winner days by preserving clean ribbon rides while avoiding losses on structurally misaligned entries.

## Mechanism

- **Entry trigger:** BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup (level rejection + EMA ribbon flip + confluence)  
- **Midday trendline gate:** Block single-trigger trendline_rejection entries between 11:30-14:00 ET (retains multi-trigger/higher-quality entries)  
- **Structure veto:** Block bearish PUT entries when 5m same-day trend classification is uptrend (using `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend`)  
- **Exit logic:** Standard BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON rules (chart stop primary, chandelier profit-lock at +5%/+15%, TP1 at +50% for 2/3 position, runner exits on ribbon re-entry or ±300% premium)  
- **Combined logic:** Both gates must PASS for entry (midday gate NOT blocking AND structure veto NOT blocking)

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ≈ 14% headline P&L (per risk-rules.md position sizing table)  
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 grinder will test 16-month window (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) using cached 5m SPY and OPRA data; selection bias risk mitigated by walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on top 3 J days  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window to be performed post-Stage-1)  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (validation on top 3 J days using cached real OPRA fills to be performed post-Stage-1)  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: 5/06 (J loser day) - potential for increased losses if structure veto misclassifies ranging markets as uptrends  
   - Max drawdown: estimated -$1,200 based on historical DD of similar filter combinations  
   - Blow-up scenario: persistent uptrend misclassification during bearish reversals causing missed entries on 4/29/5/04  
6. **Concentration:** If top-5 days = X% of P&L, state X: unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (historical concentration for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON alone is ~65% top-5; combination may alter distribution)
